title-group.article-title: A phase 1 trial of an invented CAR-T product in lymphoma

abstract.p: We report safety and efficacy of an invented CAR-T product.

body.p: Chimeric antigen receptor T cells have changed the treatment of relapsed lymphoma, but toxicity remains a concern.

sec.title: Safety
sec.p: Cytokine release syndrome occurred in 43% of patients. For its management, 26% of patients received tocilizumab and 12% received corticosteroids.
Neurologic events of grade 3 or higher were observed in four patients, all of whom recovered within two weeks of onset.

sec.title: Efficacy
sec.p:
The overall response rate was 82%, with complete responses in 54% of evaluable patients at the first assessment.
